description: Ask the human who gave you a link code (PROV-…) to link this agent to them. Returns pending (your human taps Accept in the Provian app), linked (a fleet code from any of their linked agents links directly), or already_linked. The link code is used here once; it is never a credential. Requires your agent API credential on the connection.

connection_token.description: The PROV-… link code your human gave you.

name: request_link
